title: Efficient Controllable Generation for SDXL with T2I-Adapters
Understanding social biases through the text-to-image generation lens
description: Gender, race, and age disparities in AI-generated images persist. This AIES 2023 study on text-to-image models shows that even basic prompts can lead to underrepresentation, calling for responsible bias mitigation strategies.
